subject: call an external code in shiny under Linux (Ubunto)

messages.author: dd330129cd0c5968
messages.subject: call an external code in shiny under Linux (Ubunto)
parts:
Hi guys

I have written a code user interface with shiny, where user inserts some data and then by clicking on a button "Calculate" an external file (written with C++ and compiled with visual studio) will be run and calculate the results, which will be shown on the interface. 

Under Windows the code works.

server.R:
      .....
      # Try to run the program. (*.exe)
      myExeProgramm <- eventReactive(input$go, { 
        paste(' "external_file.exe" ')
      })     

      runMyExeProgramm <- observe({
        
        system(myExeProgramm())
        
      })
     .......

ui.R
    .....
          actionButton("go", "Calculate", "primary", c("btn-large, meheh")),
   ......

I want to run it under linux (ubunto 14.04). I compiled the c++ code and there is now an executable file and it calculates well but the system command in shiny doesn't work and can't find the external executable file!
I have even changed the server.R as follow (omit ' ' in paste):

server.R:
      .....
      # Try to run the program.
      myExeProgramm <- eventReactive(input$go, { 
        paste("external_file.run")
      })     

      runMyExeProgramm <- observe({
        
        system(myExeProgramm())
        
      })
     .......

the external file is in the same subdirectory where the server.R aund ui.R and other input files are. 

Could someone helps me?

Thank you for your help in advance.

Bests

Davood

      myExeProgramm <- eventReactive(input$go, {

        system('./Bedload_Web-Linux.run')

      })    

      runMyExeProgramm <- observe({

        myExeProgramm()
       
      })


the problem was I think the "./" before the name of executable file.
